### Owner decision 2026-11-07: split top form, option B with Realizes (recorded by the lead)

Owner, on TFM_OWNER_MEMO.md and EVB_REPORT.md: adopt the split top form ("Split form, B then A"), and approve adding the Realizes hypothesis to the top statement ("Approve Realizes"). Statement: C5num ∧ (the other ten conjuncts, unchanged) ∧ (Outcome(..., bad := E_rec) ∨ E_rec), under the retained binders plus realizes : (eval H a.first).2 = ⟨e1, data1, state1⟩ ∧ (eval H (a.second ⟨e1, data1, state1⟩ saved post1 final1)).2 = ⟨e2, data2, slot, state2⟩, with native1/native2 instantiated at the AdapterRw models and the allocator at the abort indicator (ruling (bo)). Realizes links the deployed pair to the adversary's own run at the actual oracle; it is satisfiable for every pair (constant adversary), does not contain the conclusion, and does not restrict the adversary; instantiating a to a constant adversary at the top is forbidden (silent restriction). The inclusion "actual TX2 accepted with Root0 failing implies E_rec" must be PROVED (NNC_), not assumed. Numbers, range (maxQueries) and trust are unchanged; E_rec is charged once. Option A (charge E_head separately, range about 2^151.8, plus its adaptive bound through the same Realizes) remains the fallback only if B fails. Target not yet established.
Owner decision 2026-11-07, binding conditions on Realizes (owner's adviser, adopted): (1) the adversary stays universally quantified, with adaptive transaction selection and its query accounting preserved; (2) the inclusion from that same execution to E_rec is proved, never assumed; (3) BOTH the outer case-split event and Outcome's internal bad event are re-targeted to E_rec; (4) in the final probability theorem the pair is INSTANTIATED from the adversary's actual execution at H (e1/data1/state1 and e2/data2/slot/state2 defined as the outputs of eval H a.first and eval H a.second ...), so realizes holds by construction (rfl); the probability is over all H, with no conditioning on Realizes and no exclusion of attack outcomes; Realizes must never act as a filter. (5) "B provable in 400-500 lines" is a feasibility estimate; B is not finished until the host statements and the final averaging theorem compile under the gate.
Owner decision 2026-11-07 (RZ-STATE, amends condition (4) above): the allocator state is part of the ruling (bo) instantiation, not an adversary capability. The top is stated for the state-normalised adversary a⊤ (a with both allocator-state outputs replaced by true), with queries taken on a⊤; the pair is a⊤'s execution output at H, so Realizes holds by an eval-of-map lemma; nothing is filtered and no real attack is excluded (the state models allocation success, not anything the deployed attacker controls). Recorded from TAS_G0_BRIEF.md section 6.
allocator_instantiation: A := Bool; allocator := abortIndicator; state1 = final1 = state2 = final2 := true. Statement instantiation, neither hypothesis nor trust.

rulings_verbatim.### Lead ruling (bm):
### Lead ruling (bm), 2026-11-07: emitted-body route for the last rows; maximum parallelism (owner direction)

Owner, 2026-11-07: Streams B and C are paused; all build-host capacity goes to Stream A; top priority is the last OPEN spend-path rows; avoid repeating expensive failures.

(1) Diagnosis (rule 7). The 18 OPEN rows are about 2,300 lines of frozen glue (candidate.rs, r1_semantic.rs, lib.rs, r1_pool_adapter.rs, r1_pool_adapter_owned.rs). Under (bg)/(bj) each row has cost one 3-8 hour job, and the dominant cost is Kani over full-size buffers (57607-byte proof, 1768-byte checkpoint): NMN_ K059 and its 241 getter harnesses timed out or crashed at full size, and earlier entry jobs (NJN_, NLD_, NLE_, NLM_, NIV_) spent native budgets on windows that never composed. The reason (bg) mandated native segments was (be)(2): the pinned Aeneas cannot emit bodies that hold RefCell guards. That obstruction applies only to the guard-holding wrappers (lib.rs process_r1_cost_probe_instruction, r1_pool_adapter.rs process, r1_pool_adapter_owned.rs stage1/stage2 and snapshot). The owned layer (stage1_owned, stage2_owned, validate_asq8, authenticate_asq8_accounts, authenticate_invariant_release_registry, decode_lane_from_pool_release, first/first_decoded, and the candidate.rs/r1_semantic.rs drivers) holds no guards, and NIV_ already emitted frozen entry bodies with the pinned tools.

(2) Ruling. For an OPEN row whose ACTUAL frozen body the pinned Charon/Aeneas emits in a fresh receipted extraction (pins, command and source hash recorded, which also gives that body provenance under (bk)), the row MAY close by the route that closed the forest rows, with no Kani requirement: (a) the emitted body passes the (bc) post-loop-return audit, or each affected exit is certified natively; (b) opaque std primitives are interpreted under the std item ((au)); opaque SDK/runtime calls under (be)(2) and the accepted runtime rows; (c) the Lean root is a theorem about the emitted body that composes CLOSED child roots at SAME arguments; where a child root is stated over a different representation (ReviewedTranscription or native model), the job proves in Lean that the child's emitted definition equals or refines that representation on the caller-established domain; (d) OPEN children enter as RowSpec parameters ((bd)(3), (be)(1)), and the root is emitted by instantiation when the child closes; (e) the (aq)/(bf) hypothesis rules are unchanged. (bj)/(bl) stay binding for bodies that do not emit and for the guard-holding wrappers, where the owned child is havocked over its full Result type, so no full-size buffer content is ever inspected natively.

(3) Trust. This applies the existing extraction item (narrowed by (bc)) to more rows. It adds no trust class and removes nothing; it is reported to the owner as increased reliance on that item.

(4) Cost discipline, binding on every job from now on: (a) route check first: extract (or attempt to) before any Kani, and record within the first stage which route each owned row takes; (b) no Kani harness may materialize an arbitrary buffer of 1768 bytes or more unless a smaller cut has already passed and the full size is shown necessary; (c) each job audits only its own new roots; (d) a failed attempt is followed by a changed shape, never a near-duplicate; two failures of the same shape class stop that shape and record why; (e) the host-share clause is replaced by a whole-host count of six concurrent scopes, admission JSON still required. Target not yet established.
rulings_verbatim.### Lead ruling (bn):
### Lead ruling (bn), 2026-11-07: source fission for the two guard-holding stage wrappers (TX1:344 stage1, TX2:240 stage2)

(1) Finding (NMV_, evidence/stage-wrap-20261111). The canonical full-strength folds for stage1 and stage2 are proved (NMV_RslFold.fold344/fold240, TX2 parametric in V2Lib, G2 frame NMV_G2). What is missing is the native producer tying the actual compiled wrappers to those folds. Whole-parent and local-record Kani families (K017/K018, K020/K021/K023-K025) are retired, and the nullary SDK calls (program::set_return_data(&[]), Clock::get()) expose no harness-local record channel; a writable static stays banned (K-3). The pinned Aeneas cannot emit these two bodies (RefCell guard drop, (be)(2)). These are the only two guard-holding bodies left on the spend path; the dispatchers above them are guard-free in the deployed configuration (NMW_).

(2) Ruling. TX1:344 and TX2:240 use the source-fission method already accepted for the Pool (ReviewedTranscription-POOL324 and siblings, ruling (ah)): a prefix-owned copy of the frozen body in which each SDK/std/child call site (try_borrow_data/try_borrow_mut_data through snapshot, data.to_vec, copy_from_slice, set_return_data, Clock::get, stage1_owned/stage2_owned) is replaced by a call on an explicit log/window parameter receiving the same arguments, with a mechanical check that the copy equals the frozen body after whitespace normalisation and the listed name substitutions only. The fission copy is guard-free: first attempt a fresh pinned extraction of it and prove the canonical fold over the emitted body (no Kani); only if it does not emit, run Kani on the fission copy (small symbolic carriers; every buffer operation is a logged window whose law lives in Lean under (be)(2)/(au)), with reply-dependence, argument-mutant and write-footprint controls failing. The window laws are the existing SDK borrow law, std item and runtime rows (RuntimeClockSlotBinding, RuntimeReturnDataClear).

(3) Trust. Two reviewed-transcription items are added by the lead in the existing class, reclassification under option A, nothing removed: ReviewedTranscription-TX1:344 and ReviewedTranscription-TX2:240 ("the listed textual substitution preserves the frozen body's behaviour"), removal condition a native certificate on the actual frozen function. Reported to the owner. Target not yet established.
rulings_verbatim.### Lead ruling (bo):
### Lead ruling (bo), 2026-11-07: allocator binder instantiation at the top; split top form pending the owner

(1) Allocator (NNE_ALLOCATOR_FINDING.md, TFM_REPORT section 2). The headline binder allocator : Allocator A carries data only; no binder or trust row supplies the allocator success facts that accepted1/accepted2 need. Ruling: the top assembly INSTANTIATES the binder: A := Bool, allocator := the abort indicator (an allocation fails exactly when the actual invocation aborted), state1 = final1 = state2 = final2 := true. A returned-Ok actual run had every allocation succeed (a failed allocation aborts the program), so accepted1/2 follow; the attacker chooses this state, so no restriction is introduced and no trust is added. NNE_ proves the correspondence. This is an instantiation, not a hypothesis.

(2) Top form (TFM_OWNER_MEMO.md). The composed top cannot conclude the adopted headline's conjunct 4 (FJv_DResult.Outcome) off Root0; RSL.TFM.top_split concludes the other ten conjuncts and the numeric clauses unconditionally and Outcome OR the charged event. This changes the adopted statement's shape and is escalated to the owner with the memo's recommendation (split form; re-target the event to the already-charged E_rec, option B; fallback A charges E_head explicitly with range about 2^151.8 and needs an adaptive-selection bound). Until the owner decides, jobs continue; nothing is reported as the adopted headline. Target not yet established.
rulings_verbatim.### Lead ruling (bp):
### Lead ruling (bp), 2026-11-07: child-first critical path, one shared instantiation job, specifications frozen (rule 7; owner's adviser adopted)

(1) Diagnosis. Every recent job stopped at the same step: NMP_ "concrete canonical library/effect/domain interpretation", NMS_ "native carrier and source-site assembly", NNC_ "concrete I.f064 installation", NND_ "deployed sdk association", NMT_/NMV_ child packets. Each proved its row parametric in the RSL library (V2Lib, S1Lib, getters, decoders, Env) and could not instantiate it with the concrete CLOSED child roots. That is one shared missing interface, not many independent problems. The native whole-parent route is also retired for good: NMM_ (217/234, about 0.97M tokens) and NMO_ (136, about 1.24M tokens) ended without candidates.

(2) Structure, binding from now on: (a) TX1 principal effort, strictly child-first: 136, 137, 087, 094, 328, 345, then 344/333/330 by instantiation; (b) TX2 principal effort, strictly child-first: 217, 234, 233, 242, 241, then 240/221/213 by instantiation; (c) ONE shared instantiation job (LIB): concrete RSL library instances built from the CLOSED ledger roots (and NMN_064 / the NNC_ weak law), each field proved, used by both principals; (d) ONE integration job: RZ-STATE implementation, rev2 restatement patches, NMF_B actual install, minimal A1/A2 (AMN_), then the G0 top assembly; (e) no other proof jobs except named blockers. A parent job starts only when its child has a candidate, except that it may prepare its instantiation.

(3) Reporting: only a complete candidate for a ledger row, or a fully instantiated top-level interface field, counts as progress. A compiled theorem that still takes an unproved library, representation or child parameter is supporting work and is reported as such.

(4) The RSL specifications are FROZEN at revision 2 (be66076856e). A change requires a demonstrable error against the frozen source, shown by the finder, and is applied by the lead. Target not yet established.
rulings_verbatim.### Lead ruling (bq):
### Lead ruling (bq), 2026-11-07: RSL revision 3, limited to two demonstrable errors (LIB0_ F1, F2)

Under (bp)(4) the specs change only on a demonstrable error against the frozen source. LIB0_ (evidence/lib-map-20261107/LIB0_MAP.md) shows two: (F1) heap::filled/uninit (crates r0/heap.rs:5-14 at 4bb3b3f) return Err(Allocation) when the reservation fails, but RSL Env has no channel for that outcome, so the laws for filled, accNew, weightsNew, claims and tx2auth are relational and A1 is unprovable (AMN a1_forces_det). Fix: add a reservation reply to Env, bound to the headline reservation binder. (F2) TX1:179's CLOSED root requires canonical y1 values; frozen prepare never checks them; RowSpec_087's domain lacks the clause. Fix: own-input clause R4 on 087, recorded as a caller clause and discharged in 094 by canonical_scan. Nothing else changes; F3 (179 Err arm), F4 (332 allocation site), F6 (186 allocation), F7 (finishInputDom), F8 (130 mark with obs Some) are missing child lemmas provable from the existing child proofs and belong to LIB_. Target not yet established.
Ruling (bq) clarification, 2026-11-07 (LIBB_ module 12 query): the rev3 gate on the five F1 laws (filled, accNew, weightsNew, claims, tx2auth) is RETURNED-VALUE functionality, as RSL_REVISION3.md line 51 states ("abort arms do not return a value, so they do not affect returned-value determinism", which is all a1_forces_det needs): for every env, at most one RETURNED observation (Ok or Err with its value and events); abort and independently stopped prefix observations permitted by (bl)(3) may coexist. The strict Spec.Functional (one observation including aborts) is stronger than the gate and is NOT required; a returned-arm form (ReturnFunctional) defined in a LIB module and proved for each of the five laws discharges the gate. This is an interpretation of the existing frozen text, not a spec change. Target not yet established.
